goal: Prove a renderer-free WoW 1.12.1 build 5875 client can authenticate and enter a world session as an Android x86_64 executable in a PC emulator before implementing read-only Auction House and Mail support.
notes: Isolated emulator-first probe. It does not modify current MarketWorker/AUX DLL ownership, parallel_candidate, loader or updater delivery. POC-01 is PASSED on exact SHA fe9509df1cd770a352b7a8451457efbe31f8db2f, Android build run 37210672434, preflight run 37210672427, artifact 11306227666. User gameplay test on 2026-10-04 showed custom SMSG_ADDON_INFO skipped, WORLD auth PASS with build 5875, 3 characters enumerated, character login, SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD PASS and final 'PASS: entered world session'. The simultaneous desktop session on the same account was disconnected when the headless world session authenticated, providing independent server-side session acceptance evidence. AUTH login remains build 7272 while CMSG_AUTH_SESSION uses world build 5875, matching the working Windows client disassembly. Next milestone is POC-02 read-only Auction House; Mail remains deferred.
